title: Disneyland opens
description: Main Street's forced perspective, the castle weenie, the berm and the Jungle Cruise spiel set the vocabulary of spatial storytelling.

title: Freeman Tilden publishes Interpreting Our Heritage
description: The principles of heritage interpretation that themed design later borrows from museums and national parks.

title: The Haunted Mansion opens at Disneyland
description: Its stretching room becomes the archetypal pre-show and its ballroom the most famous Pepper's ghost.

title: Don Carson publishes 'Environmental Storytelling'
description: An ex-Imagineer carries theme-park storytelling techniques into game level design.

title: John Hench's Designing Disney is published
description: Hench sets down forced perspective, colour and the 'art of the show' in his own words.

title: Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey opens
description: Universal's Hogwarts queue becomes the benchmark for queue storytelling.

title: Imagineering in a Box launches on Khan Academy
description: Walt Disney Imagineering releases a free 32-video course on world-building and attraction design.

title: Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance opens
description: A queue, two pre-shows and four ride systems chained into one continuous story.

title: Star Tours – The Adventures Continue opens
description: Randomised film segments give about 1,500 different flights, a lever for re-riding.
